endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Requires admin bearer auth and returns the configured multi-source external collection scheduler cadence and the in-memory status snapshot for the active backend process without changing the public /api/health contract.

Admin-only manual operation endpoint. Fetches configured official external policy sources, upserts external_source_records, promotes public-eligible records into policies (including local_half_trip active/scheduled rows), maps source HTTP 404/410 to per-source source_unavailable, treats traffic_benefit as optional legacy, and returns per-source success/error details without exposing secrets.

Requires admin bearer auth, summarizes official external benefit records from external_source_records, and includes a recommendationPreview generated by the existing region recommendation service without performing a live network fetch.
Sends verification email and stores pending signup only after email delivery succeeds; does not create users until /api/auth/signup/complete.
Validates a pending signup token and returns the verified email without creating a user or setting a refresh cookie.
Consumes a valid pending signup token with a password, creates the user, returns AuthResponse, and sets the refresh cookie.
Returns available=false when a user with the same email already exists.
Always returns requested=true for valid email shape, stores only a SHA-256 reset token hash for existing users, and sends a reset link by SMTP when configured.
Validates the hashed token, rejects expired/used/unknown tokens, updates users.password_hash, marks the token used, and revokes existing refresh tokens.

endpoints.requiredBehavior: Sets OAuth state HttpOnly cookie and redirects to the Kakao authorization URL. Unsupported providers return 404 and missing provider config returns 503.
Sets OAuth state HttpOnly cookie and redirects to the Google OpenID Connect authorization URL. Unsupported providers return 404 and missing provider config returns 503.

On success, validates code/state, links or creates the user through social_accounts, sets the refresh cookie, clears the OAuth state cookie, and redirects to frontend /oauth/callback?redirect={safePath}. Same-email auto-link requires verified provider email; Google requires email_verified=true, while Kakao without usable verified email may create kakao_{providerId}@oauth.local. On terminal failure, does not set a refresh cookie, clears the OAuth state cookie where possible, and redirects to frontend /oauth/callback?error={access_denied|invalid_state|provider_unavailable|profile_unavailable|email_policy}&redirect={safePath} without exposing provider error_description.

endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Requires bearer auth and returns a non-persisted random nickname suggestion.
Requires bearer auth, trims the nickname, validates length 2-20, and updates users.nickname.
Updates users.region, users.travel_style, users.travel_budget and marks onboarding_completed true.
Requires bearer auth and returns null/false when no phone number is stored.
Requires bearer auth, strips whitespace, stores users.phone_number, clears users.phone_verified_at when the phone number changes, and treats blank/null as no phone number.

Requires bearer auth, normalizes and stores the requested phone number when supplied, clears users.phone_verified_at when the phone number changes, stores a hashed OTP in phone_verification_codes, rejects resend attempts within 60 seconds with 429, and sends through the configured phone verification provider boundary. PHONE_VERIFICATION_PROVIDER defaults to dev and can be set to solapi for SMS delivery.

Requires bearer auth, verifies the latest unexpired pending OTP for users.phone_number, limits failed attempts, sets phone_verification_codes.verified_at and users.phone_verified_at on success, and returns ContactInfo.
Requires bearer auth and returns true with [7, 1] lead days when no row exists.
Requires bearer auth and upserts one user_notification_settings row per user.
Provider-facing webhook; matches messageId to notification_deliveries.provider_message_id, maps statusCode 4000 to sent, ignores 2000/3000, and maps failure status codes to failed.

Ranks public recommendation-eligible external_source_records rows by active fresh regional policy count, ending-soon count, explicit KRW value, style as a non-overriding tie breaker, and profile region only as the final tie breaker; nationwide records are included only as fallback when regional candidates are fewer than limit. local_half_trip records count directly, while stay_discount records are expanded from raw_payload.eligibleAreas into regional alias candidates so the canonical stay policy is not counted as an extra +1. Legacy regional_benefit and traffic_benefit evidence is excluded from public recommendation scoring.

Returns official-benefit Policy DTOs from DB policies only. local_half_trip active/scheduled rows and active/fresh stay_discount external_source_records are promoted into policies by the collection normalization service. local_half_trip keeps backward-compatible travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} slugs. stay_discount keeps one canonical promoted policy internally, but public list/search/recommendation responses hide that canonical row and project raw_payload.eligibleAreas into stay-discount-{sidoSlug}-{citySlug} regional aliases; alias rows are actionable and omit/null actionStatus. regional_benefit is legacy summary evidence for the same half-trip program and is hidden/excluded from public policy promotion, recommendation, and raw detail fallback; traffic_benefit is optional legacy source evidence and is not promoted into public policies. local_half_trip records that are ended, unknown-status, or stale are hidden from public policy lists by setting policies.status to hidden when a promoted policy exists. sourceType remains in the DTO for compatibility/internal diagnostics, but user-facing UI must not expose internal/external wording and all exposed normalized policies share save/trip behavior. Policy category is a benefit/source type; TravelMonth records derive category from source URL/sourceCategory and do not use travelStyles for category filtering. Hidden policies are excluded by backend query and public Policy.status is not exposed in v1.

Also accepts travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} slugs for normalized TravelMonth/local_half_trip policies and stay-discount-{sidoSlug}-{citySlug} aliases for the canonical stay_discount policy. stay_discount alias detail echoes the requested alias slug/region while save/remove/trip mutations persist canonical Policy.id and echo the request alias in mutation responses. A temporary raw external_source_records fallback may resolve active/fresh local_half_trip and stay_discount detail during migration gaps, but regional_benefit, traffic_benefit, and non-active/non-fresh records do not resolve through the public fallback. Hidden policies return 404 from the public detail route.
Requires bearer auth and returns current user's saved policies.
Requires bearer auth and returns distinct policies linked to trips owned by or shared with the current user.
Requires bearer auth and stores user_saved_policies idempotently.
Requires bearer auth and removes user_saved_policies idempotently.
